opening.text: I've been getting short of breath, feeling tired, and getting dizzy. These symptoms have been going on for a month, and I can't climb more than one flight of stairs without getting short of breath and dizzy. I have high blood pressure and take medication for it. I also smoke a pack of cigarettes a day, and have for the past 50 years.
